name: start-supervision
description: After a successful run_launch, start the supervise-run workflow for the new run id so the run is watched and auto-healed.

action.prompt: A new training run was just launched via run_launch. Read the tool result to find the new run id, then start the supervise-run workflow with that run id so the run is watched, auto-healed and reported. Do not take any other action.
